scope: Deterministic read-timeout accounting fixture; production runner and performance deadlines remain unchanged.

ci_failure.step: Test performance workload and evidence guards
ci_failure.failure: Expected three failed reads, observed one; two offered reads may correctly be refused while the first completion fsync owns the cell.

regression.before: Original case fails deterministically with a 40ms delay after each real fsync: one failed read instead of three. The delay exists only in the retained reproducer.
regression.after: The accounting-only case uses controlled clock advancement and completed futures. Three invocations, three timeouts, zero ambiguity, no blocked cell, no generator rejection and unchanged state remain mandatory. Real-thread slow-server/admission coverage remains in separate passing cases.

limitations: Local Python validation uses 3.14.6, not a free-threaded build. Fresh-head CI must qualify both ABIs.
This corrects a qualification fixture race; it does not fix the physical status-stage delay or client EADDRNOTAVAIL refusal. The failed physical workload remains unqualified.
